store.summary: Amiibo library and emulator for the CardputerZero with the NFC Cap
store.description: ZeroTag turns the CardputerZero and its Cap CC1101 (ST25R3916) into an amiibo emulator. Browse your own backups, create blank signed amiibo from a 954-character catalogue, emulate them on a Switch, 3DS or Wii U, and keep what the game writes. Optional UID rotation gives a new identity after each read. Interface in French, English and Japanese. You provide your own key_retail.bin; nothing from Nintendo is bundled.
